name: Bavarian Cloud Hefeweizen
brief_description: Traditional German wheat beer with notes of banana and clove, naturally cloudy with a smooth, refreshing finish.
grain_bill: German Wheat Malt, German Pilsner Malt
malts: German Wheat Malt (60%), German Pilsner Malt (40%)
flavor_profile: Classic banana and clove flavors from traditional German yeast, with a creamy wheat character and refreshing citrus notes.
aroma: Prominent banana and clove spice aromas with hints of fresh bread and subtle floral hops
appearance: Cloudy pale gold with a thick, long-lasting white head typical of authentic hefeweizen
content:
Bavarian Cloud Hefeweizen

Our homage to the classic German weissbier tradition, brewed with authentic German ingredients and techniques. This naturally cloudy wheat beer showcases the beautiful interplay between traditional Bavarian wheat malt and the distinctive character of German weissbier yeast.

Brewing Notes

Brewed with 60% German wheat malt and 40% German Pilsner malt, following traditional Bavarian brewing methods. The signature banana and clove flavors come naturally from our authentic Weihenstephan yeast strain, fermented at carefully controlled temperatures to achieve the perfect balance.

Food Pairings

  • Traditional German fare like bratwurst and pretzels
  • Light salads and fresh vegetables
  • Seafood and white fish
  • Lemon-based desserts and fruit tarts

name: Berry Bliss Sour
brief_description: Tart and refreshing sour ale with fresh blackberries, blueberries, and raspberries. Perfectly balanced sweet and sour.
grain_bill: Pilsner Malt, Wheat Malt, Munich Malt
malts: Pilsner Malt, Wheat Malt, Munich Malt
flavor_profile: Bright berry tartness balanced with subtle sweetness. Clean, crisp finish with lingering fruit notes.
aroma: Fresh mixed berries with hints of vanilla and light funk from wild fermentation
appearance: Deep ruby red with purple hues and a light pink foam head
content:
Berry Bliss Sour

Our seasonal celebration of summer's finest berries, this kettle sour showcases the perfect harmony between tart and sweet. We carefully balance three types of berries to create a complex yet refreshing drinking experience.

Fruit Forward Philosophy

Berry Bliss features over 2 pounds of fruit per barrel, using only the finest:

  • Blackberries: Provide deep color and rich, jammy sweetness
  • Blueberries: Add subtle tartness and beautiful purple hues
  • Raspberries: Contribute bright acidity and aromatic intensity

All fruit is sourced from local farms within 50 miles of our brewery, ensuring peak freshness and supporting our community.

Food Pairings

  • Fresh salads with goat cheese and vinaigrette
  • Grilled chicken or pork
  • Berry desserts and cheesecake
  • Soft cheeses like brie or camembert
  • Dark chocolate

name: Bohemian Pilsner
brief_description: Traditional Czech-style pilsner with noble Saaz hops, crisp malt character, and a clean, refreshing finish.
flavor_profile: Clean, crisp malt sweetness balanced by spicy, floral hop character. Dry finish with subtle bread notes.
aroma: Delicate floral and spicy hop aroma with light grainy malt and a hint of sulfur
appearance: Brilliant pale golden color with a dense, long-lasting white foam head
content:
Bohemian Pilsner

Our tribute to the world's first golden lager, created in 1842 in Plzeň, Czech Republic. This authentic interpretation showcases the elegance and balance that made pilsner the world's most popular beer style.

Brewing Notes

We honor centuries of Czech brewing tradition with authentic techniques:

  • Decoction Mashing: Traditional triple decoction for enhanced malt character
  • Floor Malted Grains: Bohemian Pilsner malt for authentic flavor
  • Noble Hops: 100% Czech Saaz hops from the Žatec region
  • Extended Lagering: 6 weeks of cold conditioning for smoothness

Food Pairings

  • Traditional Czech cuisine (goulash, schnitzel, sausages)
  • Grilled meats and barbecue
  • Light seafood dishes
  • Soft cheeses and pretzels
  • Spicy Asian cuisine

Awards & Recognition

  • 2024 World Beer Cup: Silver Medal, Czech Pilsner Category
  • 2023 Great American Beer Festival: Bronze Medal, German/Czech Pilsner
  • Local Favorite: Voted "Best Lager" by City Paper readers

Classic American Lager

Our tribute to the great American lager tradition - a clean, honest beer that prioritizes drinkability and refreshment. Brewed with traditional American ingredients including corn and rice, this lager represents the craft brewery's take on America's most popular beer style.

Brewing Notes

Brewed with 6-row barley malt and adjuncts of flaked rice and corn grits, following traditional American lager techniques. Extended cold conditioning creates the signature clean, crisp character that makes this beer incredibly drinkable.

Food Pairings

  • Grilled burgers and hot dogs
  • Light seafood and fish tacos
  • Spicy foods and barbecue
  • Perfect for lawn mowing and tailgating

name: Golden Abbey Tripel
brief_description: Complex Belgian strong ale with fruity esters, spicy phenols, and a deceptively smooth finish despite its high alcohol content.
grain_bill: Belgian Pilsner Malt, Candi Sugar, Munich Malt
flavor_profile: Complex layers of pear, apple, and banana esters balanced with spicy clove and pepper phenols. Subtle honey sweetness with a dry, warming finish.
aroma: Intense fruity and spicy aromas with notes of pear, orange peel, and coriander spice
appearance: Brilliant golden color with a dense, persistent white head and excellent clarity
content:
Golden Abbey Tripel

Our interpretation of the classic Belgian Tripel style, inspired by the great Trappist monasteries of Belgium. This deceptively strong ale combines complex Belgian yeast character with the finest European malts and hops, creating a beer that's both contemplative and celebratory.

Brewing Notes

Brewed with traditional Belgian Pilsner malt and pure candi sugar, this tripel undergoes extended fermentation with authentic Belgian yeast. The result is a beer with remarkable depth and complexity that belies its clean, golden appearance.

Food Pairings

  • Roasted poultry and game birds
  • Aged cheeses like Gouda and Gruyère
  • Spicy Asian cuisine
  • Rich chocolate desserts and crème brûlée

name: Golden Wheat
brief_description: Light and refreshing wheat beer with hints of citrus and coriander, perfect for any season.
grain_bill: Wheat Malt, 2-Row Pale Malt, Vienna Malt
malts: Wheat Malt, 2-Row Pale Malt, Vienna Malt

content:
Golden Wheat - Sunshine in a Glass

A classic American wheat beer that's as refreshing as a summer breeze. This light and approachable beer features a smooth wheat character with subtle spice notes that make it perfect for any occasion.

Brewing Notes

Crafted with a 50/50 blend of wheat and barley malts, this beer showcases the classic wheat beer character while maintaining excellent drinkability. A touch of Vienna malt adds depth and complexity to the grain bill.

Traditional German noble hops provide a gentle, floral bitterness that complements rather than competes with the wheat character. The result is a perfectly balanced, sessionable beer.

Food Pairings

  • Light salads and seafood
  • Soft cheeses and pretzels
  • Grilled chicken and vegetables
  • Fruit tarts and lemon desserts
  • Spicy Mexican cuisine

Hazy Horizon IPA

Our flagship New England IPA represents everything we love about the hazy revolution. Brewed with a generous amount of wheat malt and flaked oats for that signature smooth, pillowy mouthfeel that defines the style.

Brewing Notes

Unlike traditional West Coast IPAs, Hazy Horizon focuses on hop flavor and aroma rather than bitterness. We dry-hop this beer with over 3 pounds per barrel of premium hops, creating an intensely aromatic and flavorful experience without the harsh bite.

  • Fresh seafood and sushi
  • Citrus-forward desserts
  • Sharp cheeses like aged cheddar

name: Hoppy Trails IPA
brief_description: A bold and hoppy West Coast IPA with citrus and pine notes that will take your taste buds on an adventure.
flavor_profile: Bold citrus and pine with balanced malt sweetness
aroma: Bright citrus, floral hops, and subtle pine
appearance: Golden amber with a persistent white head
content:
Hoppy Trails IPA - A Journey Through Flavor

Our flagship IPA is a bold expression of American hop character, featuring a carefully curated blend of Pacific Northwest hops that deliver bright citrus and resinous pine flavors. This West Coast-style IPA showcases the perfect balance between malt sweetness and hop bitterness.

Brewing Notes

Brewed with premium 2-Row Pale malt as the base, we add Munich malt for depth and Crystal 60L for a touch of caramel sweetness that balances the hop intensity. The grist is kept simple to let the hops shine through.

Our hop schedule features three additions: Cascade provides the floral foundation, Centennial brings the citrus punch, and Simcoe delivers those piney, resinous notes that IPA lovers crave. We dry hop for maximum aroma impact.

Food Pairings

  • Spicy Thai curry dishes
  • Sharp aged cheddar
  • Grilled salmon with herbs
  • Dark chocolate desserts
  • Buffalo wings and other spicy bar food

name: Midnight Barrel Imperial Stout
brief_description: Massive imperial stout aged 18 months in bourbon barrels, with notes of dark chocolate, vanilla, and warming bourbon character.
grain_bill: Pale Malt, Munich Malt, Chocolate Malt, Roasted Barley, Crystal 120L, Black Patent
malts: Pale Malt, Munich Malt, Chocolate Malt, Roasted Barley, Crystal 120L, Black Patent
flavor_profile: Rich dark chocolate and coffee flavors enhanced by bourbon barrel character. Notes of vanilla, caramel, and oak with a warming alcohol finish.
aroma: Intense chocolate and roasted coffee aromas with prominent bourbon, vanilla, and oak barrel notes
appearance: Pitch black with a tan head, full opacity typical of imperial stouts
content:
Midnight Barrel Imperial Stout

Our most ambitious brewing project - a massive imperial stout that spends 18 months slumbering in hand-selected bourbon barrels. This limited release represents the pinnacle of our barrel aging program, with only 200 bottles produced annually.

Brewing Notes

This beer begins as a 10% ABV imperial stout base, carefully crafted with six different malts to create layers of chocolate, coffee, and caramel flavors. After primary fermentation, it's transferred to bourbon barrels where it develops its signature complexity over 18 months of patient aging.

Barrel Selection

Each barrel is carefully selected from premium bourbon distilleries, contributing unique character from previous bourbon aging. The extended aging process allows the beer to extract vanilla, oak tannins, and residual bourbon flavors while smoothing the high alcohol content.

Food Pairings

  • Dark chocolate desserts and tiramisu
  • Aged steaks and barbecued meats
  • Strong cheeses like Stilton and aged cheddar
  • Cigars and after-dinner contemplation

content:
Midnight Stout - Darkness Awaits

A bold and complex imperial stout that embodies the mystery of the night. This rich, full-bodied beer delivers layers of roasted malt complexity with subtle bourbon barrel influences that warm the soul.

Brewing Notes

Our grain bill features a foundation of 2-Row Pale malt with generous additions of Chocolate malt and Roasted Barley for deep color and roasted flavors. Flaked oats add a silky mouthfeel that makes this stout incredibly smooth.

Aged for 6 months in bourbon barrels, this stout develops complex vanilla and oak characteristics that complement the roasted malt backbone. The extended aging process creates a harmonious blend of flavors.

Food Pairings

  • Dark chocolate truffles
  • Vanilla ice cream
  • BBQ brisket
  • Blue cheese
  • Tiramisu and coffee desserts

name: Nut Brown English Ale
brief_description: Traditional English brown ale with rich malt character, subtle hop balance, and notes of toffee, nuts, and biscuit from specialty malts.
grain_bill: English Pale Malt, Crystal 60L, Chocolate Malt, Victory Malt
malts: English Pale Malt, Crystal 60L, Chocolate Malt, Victory Malt

content:
Nut Brown English Ale

A faithful recreation of the classic English brown ale style, showcasing the beauty of traditional English malts and hops. This malt-forward ale emphasizes the rich, complex flavors that made brown ales a pub favorite throughout England.

Brewing Notes

Brewed exclusively with English ingredients, including Maris Otter pale malt and authentic English crystal and chocolate malts. The traditional English ale yeast produces subtle fruity esters that complement rather than compete with the rich malt character.

Food Pairings

  • Roasted meats and shepherd's pie
  • Aged cheddar and Stilton cheese
  • Hearty stews and casseroles
  • Chocolate desserts and bread pudding

name: Wild Cherry Barrel Sour
brief_description: Complex sour ale aged in wine barrels with wild cherries, featuring bright acidity balanced by subtle fruit sweetness and funky barrel character.
grain_bill: Pilsner Malt, Wheat Malt, Munich Malt
malts: Pilsner Malt, Wheat Malt, Munich Malt
flavor_profile: Bright cherry tartness with complex funky notes from wild fermentation. Subtle oak and wine barrel character with a crisp, refreshing finish.
aroma: Intense cherry and berry aromas with earthy, barnyard funk and subtle wine barrel oakiness
appearance: Deep ruby-amber color with a thin pink head and brilliant clarity
content:
Wild Cherry Barrel Sour

Our wild fermentation project showcases the beauty of controlled chaos. This complex sour ale spends over two years in red wine barrels with our house culture of wild yeasts and bacteria, then undergoes a final aging period with fresh Michigan cherries.

Wild Fermentation Process

This beer begins its journey as a simple wort of pilsner and wheat malts, then is inoculated with our carefully cultivated mixed culture containing Brettanomyces, Lactobacillus, and Pediococcus. The wild fermentation creates complex esters and acids that develop over 18+ months.

Cherry Addition

In the final six months, we add 2 pounds per gallon of fresh Michigan tart cherries, allowing the fruit to integrate naturally with the sour base. The cherries add brightness and color while complementing the existing acidity.

Food Pairings

  • Fresh goat cheese and charcuterie
  • Duck confit and rich poultry dishes
  • Dark chocolate and berry desserts
  • Strong aged cheeses like aged Gouda
